source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.13, printed pages 226-227.

blocks.text: Electrochemical cell ka voltage concentration, temperature aur gas ke pressure par bhi depend karta hai. Is liye electrode potentials ka muqabla karte waqt standard conditions (muqarrar halaat) istemal karni chahiyen.

items: half-cell ka electrode potential standard hydrogen electrode ke muqable mein napa jaye.

blocks.text: In conditions mein napa gaya electrode potential standard electrode potential kehlata hai. Is ka symbol E° hai aur ise ‘E standard’ bola jata hai.

blocks.title: Standard electrode potential
blocks.text: Kisi half-cell ka standard electrode potential woh voltage hai jo standard conditions mein napa jaye jab doosra half-cell standard hydrogen electrode (SHE) ho.

blocks.prompt: E° ki tareef mein concentration aur temperature kyun muqarrar kiye jate hain?
blocks.explanation: Electrode ka equilibrium (jaise Cu²⁺ + 2e⁻ ⇌ Cu) concentration aur temperature badalne se shift hota hai, aur voltage bhi badal jata hai. Sab half-cells ki values ka sahi muqabla tabhi ho sakta hai jab sab ek jaisi conditions (1.00 mol dm⁻³, 298 K, 101 kPa) mein napi jayen.

items: Standard conditions: 1.00 mol dm⁻³, 25 °C (298 K), 1 atm (101 kPa), SHE ke muqable.
In mein napa voltage = E° (‘E standard’).
